Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 89/2024

Dear Mr. Sathe,

Thank you for meeting us on 21 April 2025 about your dispute with M/s Chatterjee Technologies Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the employer offered to settle. The matter is listed before the Coimbatore Labour Court.

Our advice is to negotiate a settlement of gratuity and notice pay. Please collect the salary slips and the gratuity calculation and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
